text: 55-year-old woman. The patient reports a 2-month history of insidious onset left shoulder pain, worsening with extreme ranges of motion and activity. speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Rotator Cuff Tendinopathy/Impingement Syndrome.

The patient's presentation of insidious onset pain in a 55-year-old woman, exacerbated by extreme range of motion and activity, with functional limitations like difficulty brushing hair, is highly characteristic of rotator cuff pathology. Given her age and the specific nature of the pain, I suspect a rotator cuff tear or significant tendinopathy. To confirm the diagnosis and assess the extent of any structural damage, I need to see imaging.
